milestone: Worker owner-bound lease renewal / A-10 / A-15
scenario: A running job renews its existing lease only for the current owner; a stale reclaim cannot steal a renewed job, and renewal stops before terminal queue writes.

failure_before_repair.command: uv run --isolated --with-editable . --extra dev python -m pytest tests/test_queue.py -q -k "renew_lease"
failure_before_repair.result: failed: InMemoryJobQueue had no renew_lease method; 2 renewal tests failed

failure_before_repair.command: uv run --isolated --with-editable . --extra dev python -m pytest tests/test_runner.py -q -k "renews_a_running_job"
failure_before_repair.result: failed: run_once had no lease_renew_interval_seconds contract and the blocked handler never reached the renewal proof

repair: Added owner-bound InMemory and PostgreSQL renew_lease implementations that update only locked_at/updated_at when status is running and locked_by matches.

Added a runner Protocol renewal contract and a per-job stoppable daemon renewer; cadence defaults to one third of the existing lease and is injectable only for deterministic tests, not a new deployment env.
Stopped and joined renewal before terminal success/failure/retry writes; renewal ownership loss stops the renewer and terminal writes retain their existing owner guard.
Added InMemory owner/stale tests, PostgreSQL SQL-shape and conditional integration assertions, and an Event-barrier slow-handler runner test.
